title: Mizpah
sourceLines: -1. A city allotted to the tribe of Benjamin Jos 18:26
.And decree the penalty to be visited upon the Benjamites for their maltreatment of the Levite’s concubine Jud 20:10
.Assembled by Samuel so that he could reprove them for their idolatry 1Sa 7:5
.They crown Saul king of Israel at 1Sa 10:17-25
.Temporarily the capitol of the country after the people of Israel had been carried away captive 2Ki 25:23,25; Jer 40:6-15; 41:1-14
.David puts his parents into the care of the king of 1Sa 22:3,4
-4. A city in the lowlands of Judah Jos 15:38
